assignments.reason: Torah innovations (chidushei Torah) are essentially Torah — the creative act of renewing Torah teachings. The Torah text states that through chidushei Torah, heavens and earth are created and blessings flow. Torah is already the anchor of Package 4 (Torah = contentment = Tree of Life). The essential nature of chidushei Torah is Torah study and creativity, placing it in the Torah/contentment domain.

The flowing of all blessings and sustenance to the world is essentially the domain of blessings (ברכות, already in Package 4) and the Tzaddik's light. The text connects this directly to the heavens being God's treasure-house of goodness. Its essential nature is divine abundance — the same reality as the contentment/light/blessings cluster.

The creation of heavens and earth through Torah innovations is essentially a cosmic-creative act of Torah. The Zohar passage cited ('ma ana avadi shemaya ve-ar'a be-miluli') identifies Torah speech as the creative force. This cosmic creation is the structural basis for the blessings/sustenance that flow through the Tzaddik's Torah domain.

Charity — the giver influencing the receiver — is essentially the act of the Tzaddik giving to Knesset Israel. The proof text explicitly states: through tzedakah the giver gives to the receiver, creating the union of Tzaddik and Knesset Israel, which is the spreading of the yeri'ah (tent-cloth) over the Aron. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik's giving, the core dynamic of Package 4.

The union of Tzaddik and Knesset Israel is essentially the same concept as 'יחוד צדיק וכנסת ישראל' already in Package 4. This is a variant node_id for the same conceptual reality — the Tzaddik spreads heaven like a tent-cloth and gives to the receiving vessel below. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik/Knesset Israel relationship.

Attaching one's thought to the World to Come is the very definition of זכרון (memory) in this Torah. The text opens: 'the essence of memory is to always remember the World to Come... and through attaching one's thought to the World to Come, the unification of Hashem Elokai is made.' This IS the act of memory itself — the particular (pratiyut) form of attachment to the World to Come.

The unification of the Divine Name (Hashem Elokai) is essentially the World to Come itself. The text states: 'ה' אלקים is the full Name, which is the World to Come' (from Saba de-Mishpatim). The existing node 'ה אלקי' in Package 1 is the bechina form; this eitza node describes the ACHIEVEMENT of that unification. Its essential nature is the Divine Name / World to Come.

The eye as the seat of memory — 'ulzikharon bein einekha' (for a remembrance between your eyes). The proof text teaches that memory fundamentally depends on the eye. This is not the evil eye (Package 3) but the positive capacity of the eye to hold memory. Its essential nature is the faculty of memory — the eye as the organ through which remembrance is maintained.

Remembering oneself in the World to Come is a direct expression of זכרון — the core concept of Package 1. The Torah teaches that through niggun and simchah one can 'remember oneself in the World to Come.' Its essential nature is memory/remembrance of the eternal destination.

Guarding/preserving memory is essentially about memory itself — the protective maintenance of the זכרון faculty. The text teaches that to guard memory one must guard oneself from falling into evil eye. Its essential nature is the preservation of the memory faculty, the core of Package 1.
Guarding of memory (shmirat ha-zikharon) is a synonym/variant of 'לשמר הזכרון' — the preservation of the memory faculty. Its essential nature is memory, the core of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נשמר הזכרון כנ"ל. דהינו שעל־ידי־זה זוכה לזכר תכליתו האחרון לעולם הבא, ולחשב תמיד על סופו ולאדבקא מחשבתה בעלמא דאתי תמיד
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the state where memory is guarded, resulting in constant remembrance of one's ultimate destination in the World to Come and continuous attachment of thought to the World to Come. Its essential nature is entirely about memory and the World to Come — the very definition of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: יכולין לקבל רוח נבואה, רוח הקדש
assignments.reason: The ability to receive prophetic spirit / holy spirit is essentially the state of ruach nevu'ah — the good spirit that IS memory and attachment to the World to Come. Ruach nevu'ah is already in Package 1 as a bechina of zikharon. This node describes the capacity to receive that spirit. Its essential nature is prophecy/holy spirit = memory.

assignments.node_id: מברר הרוח טובה מן הרוח רעה, שזהו בחינת רוח נבואה
assignments.reason: This node explicitly identifies itself: 'clarifying the good spirit from the evil spirit, which is the aspect of prophetic spirit.' The node's own text declares its essential nature as ruach nevu'ah (prophetic spirit), which is a core member of Package 1. While the clarification process happens through music (Package 5), the RESULT described here is prophecy itself.

assignments.node_id: ברור הרוח טובה מן הרוח רעה
assignments.reason: The clarification/birur of good spirit from evil spirit is essentially the PROCESS of the niggun — the action of sorting and separating through musical performance. The proof text states: 'the essence of the melody is through the clarification of the good spirit from the evil spirit.' Unlike the previous node which self-identifies as ruach nevu'ah, this node names the process itself. The birur IS the niggun, and niggun/simchah/yad are the core instruments of Package 5.

The joy that comes through the musician playing with the hand is essentially the simchah/yad/menagen-beyad cluster. Package 5 already contains שמחה (joy), יד (hand), and מנגן ביד (playing with hand). This node is a more elaborated form of the same concept — joy produced through the hand-instrument. Its essential nature is joy through the mitzvah-instrument of music.

Melody and joy (niggun u-simchah) is a compound of two concepts already in Package 5: niggun (music) and simchah (joy). Its essential nature is the practice of joyful music-making — the daily instrument through which ordinary people subdue the imagination and maintain memory.

Melody (niggun) is essentially the musical practice — the instrument through which the good spirit is clarified. Package 5 already contains מנגן ביד (playing music with the hand). Niggun by itself IS the practice of music-making, the core daily instrument of this package.

Melody with the hand (niggun ba-yad) is essentially identical to 'מנגן ביד' already in Package 5. Both describe the practice of playing music with the hand. Its essential nature is the hand-instrument of joy.
Melody with the hand, which is the aspect of joy — this node explicitly combines niggun ba-yad with simchah, both core elements of Package 5. Its essential nature is the joy-instrument of the hand.

Playing with the hand on the musical instrument (kli zemer) is essentially the practice of music-making with the hand. Package 5's core includes יד (hand) and מנגן ביד (playing with hand). This more detailed description of the same act belongs in the same domain — the physical practice/instrument of joy.

assignments.node_id: כשיש לו בחינת יד הנ"ל, המלקט ומברר בחינת הרוח טובה מן הרוח רעה
assignments.reason: When one has the aspect of the hand that gathers and clarifies the good spirit from the evil spirit — this is essentially the yad (hand) in its active function. The proof text teaches that through the hand the prophet subdues the medame. The essential nature is the hand as the instrument of clarification — the yad of Package 5.

Gathering the spirit (melakket ha-ruach) is essentially the action performed BY the hand — the musician's hand gathers and sorts the spirit through playing. The proof text places this in the Proverbs verse 'mi asar ruach bechofnav' — gathering spirit in the palms/hands. Its essential nature is the hand's gathering function, the core practice of Package 5.

assignments.node_id: בלילה, שאז הוא פקדונות הרוחות, בחינת: "בידך אפקיד רוחי" הנ"ל, אזי הזמן לקבץ הרוח טובה מתוך הרוח רעה. הינו שאז עקר הזמן של ההתבודדות, להתבודד בינו לבין קונו, ולפרש שיחתו לפני השם יתברך, לשוח עם לבבו, ולחפש הרוח טובה, דהינו הנקדות טובות שיש בו עדין, לבררם מתוך הרוח רעה. שזהו בחינת נגון ה
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the nighttime practice of hitbodedut — secluded prayer and self-examination where one searches for the good points within oneself, clarifying the good spirit from the evil. The text explicitly identifies this practice as 'bchinat niggun' (the aspect of melody). Its essential nature is a spiritual practice/instrument — the daily devotional act through which the ordinary person gathers the good spirit. This is the same domain as tefillin, tzitzit, tefillah, and niggun — the practical instruments of Package 5 through which holiness descends into daily life.

The subjugation of the imagination (hakna'at ha-medame) is essentially about the medame — it names the state of the evil imagination being subdued. While the cause of subduing is joy/music (Package 5), the concept itself is defined by the medame. Its essential nature is the imagination in its subdued state. Polarity is evil because the medame itself is the evil force, even when being defeated.

Subduing the power of imagination — a variant formulation of הכנעת המדמה. Its essential nature is about the koach ha-medame (evil imagination), the central concept of Package 2. Polarity is evil as it names the evil force being acted upon.

Subduing the imagination — another variant describing the defeat of the medame. The proof text places this in the context of the hand (yad) overcoming the imagination: 'uv-yad ha-nevi'im adameh.' Its essential nature is the medame being overcome. Polarity is evil as the concept is defined by the evil force.

The imagination is subdued, and then one merits memory — a compound node where the primary subject is the medame being subdued (the memory is a consequence). Its essential nature is about the medame in its defeated state. Polarity is evil as it names the evil imagination.

The eye being guarded from the power of imagination — this describes the protection of the eye. The eye (ayin) in its vulnerable state is the domain of Package 3 (evil eye = death of heart). This node describes the eye being PROTECTED from the medame. While polarity is good (it is a positive state), its essential nature is the eye-faculty and its susceptibility, placing it in the eye/heart domain of Package 3. Polarity is good because this is the guarded/healthy state of the eye.

assignments.node_id: לשמר את עצמו שלא יפל לבחינת רע עין, לבחינת מיתת הלב
assignments.reason: Guarding oneself from falling into evil eye and death of the heart — this node is defined by the concepts of ra ayin and mitat ha-lev, the core of Package 3. Though polarity is good (it is the act of guarding against evil), its essential nature is the evil-eye/death-of-heart domain. The concepts named ARE the Package 3 concepts.

The heart being guarded from the power of imagination — the heart (lev) is the central concept of Package 3 (death of the heart, heart = tablets). This node describes the heart in its protected state. Its essential nature is the heart-faculty and its vulnerability to the medame, placing it in the heart/eye domain. Polarity is good as this is the positive guarded state.

assignments.node_id: יכול לשפך לבו כמים לפני ה
assignments.reason: Being able to pour out one's heart like water before God — this is the positive state of the heart when alive (not dead). The heart (lev) and water (mayim) are both already in Package 3, where lev = luchot and mayim = lev. The proof text connects this to 'shifkhi ka-mayim libekh' — the same verse linking water and heart in Package 3. Its essential nature is the living heart pouring itself out, the positive pole of the heart/water domain.

assignments.node_id: צורר מים בשמלה, ששומר הלב שלא ישלט עליו המדמה
assignments.reason: Wrapping water in a garment, guarding the heart so the imagination does not rule it — this node is defined by the heart (lev) and water (mayim), both in Package 3. The proof text explicitly identifies mayim = lev (from 'shifkhi ka-mayim libekh'). Its essential nature is the protection of the heart from the medame, the positive counterpart to mitat ha-lev.
